related.title: Sigstore Cosign：身分限制與簽章驗證
related.titleEn: Sigstore Cosign: identity constraints in signature verification
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付10份判定表、四關政策、拒絕測試及可重跑的證明審查流程。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ten decisions, four-gate policy, rejection fixtures and reproducible provenance review.
related.difference: 把密碼學有效、預期身分、OIDC發行者與產物摘要分成獨立欄，為每種不符建立拒絕案例。
related.differenceEn: Separate cryptographic validity, expected identity, OIDC issuer and artifact digest, with a rejection case for every mismatch.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 四項條件必須同時成立；簽章有效只證明特定身分簽過，不能自動信任任意建置者。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 10份合成證明：8份摘要正確，其中7份有允許的配對，其中6份來源與參數也符合。 最後接受6/10=60%；不能把每關通過比例相加。
政策接受是交集；不能把「某人簽過」等同「預期發布流程簽過」。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個合成驗證包中10個密碼學有效；其中8個符合身分，7個也符合發行者與摘要。 通過率7/12=58.3333%，密碼學有效率10/12=83.3333%，兩者不同。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All four conditions must hold; a valid signature proves a signer signed, not that any builder is trusted. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Ten synthetic attestations include eight correct digests, seven of those with allowed pairs, and six of those with matching source and parameters. Final acceptance is 6/10=60%; gate percentages cannot be added.

Policy acceptance is an intersection; someone signed is not equivalent to the intended release workflow signed. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Of twelve synthetic bundles, ten are cryptographically valid; eight match identity and seven also match issuer and digest. Policy pass rate is 58.3333%, distinct from cryptographic validity of 83.3333%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kubernetes RBAC：加法權限與服務帳號契約
related.titleEn: Kubernetes RBAC: additive permissions and service-account contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付10份判定表、四關政策、拒絕測試及可重跑的證明審查流程。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ten decisions, four-gate policy, rejection fixtures and reproducible provenance review.
related.difference: 把主體、namespace、資源與動詞展開成集合，找出多個綁定合併後多出的權限。
related.differenceEn: Expand subject, namespace, resource and verb tuples into sets and identify excess permissions after combining bindings.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 四項條件必須同時成立；簽章有效只證明特定身分簽過，不能自動信任任意建置者。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 10份合成證明：8份摘要正確，其中7份有允許的配對，其中6份來源與參數也符合。 最後接受6/10=60%；不能把每關通過比例相加。
有效權限是所有適用允許集合的聯集；移除一個綁定不代表該權限必定消失。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 Role A允許6個不同動作，Role B允許5個，兩者重疊2個；控制器實際只需4個，且這4個全部包含在原始與變更後的允許聯集中。 聯集6+5−2=9個，額外權限9−4=5個。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All four conditions must hold; a valid signature proves a signer signed, not that any builder is trusted. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Ten synthetic attestations include eight correct digests, seven of those with allowed pairs, and six of those with matching source and parameters. Final acceptance is 6/10=60%; gate percentages cannot be added.

Effective permissions are the union of applicable allows; removing one binding does not guarantee revocation. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Role A permits six distinct actions and B five, with two overlapping; the controller needs four actions, all contained in both the original and changed permission unions. The union contains 6+5−2=9 actions, five beyond the four required.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
